column2: A model requests an instance of its exogenous parameters and its indexes.
The model sends an ExogenousInstanceRequest to the ExogenousInstanceBuilder by RPC.
The ExogenousInstanceBuilder deploys an ExogenousInstanceEmitter on Anvil for each ExogenousInstanceRequest.
The ExogenousInstanceEmitter emits the ExogenousInstanceRequest's exogenous parameters as an ExogenousParameters event and its indexes as an Indexes event.
The ExogenousInstanceBuilder reads the ExogenousInstanceRequest's ExogenousParameters event and its Indexes event from Anvil.
The ExogenousInstanceBuilder writes the ExogenousInstanceRequest's instance into the Connect database.
The ExogenousInstanceBuilder informs the model that the instance is in the Connect database.
The model reads the ExogenousInstanceRequest's instance from the Connect database.
